judge.summary: The patient requested to reschedule an existing appointment that did not exist in the system. The agent hallucinated that it found the appointment, proceeded to 'reschedule' it, and confirmed the cancellation of the non-existent Tuesday slot. The agent successfully booked a new time, but failed to identify that the original appointment was not in the system.

conversation_quality.notes: The conversation flowed well, but the agent's failure to verify the existence of the appointment undermined the logic of the interaction.

agent_quality.notes: The agent failed to perform a record lookup and instead hallucinated an existing appointment to satisfy the user's request.

technical_quality.notes: Latency was acceptable, but the agent's logic was flawed.

candidate_issues.title: Hallucinated appointment record
candidate_issues.quote: I see your appointment with Doctor Chen for next Tuesday, and I can help you reschedule that to Thursday
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have stated it could not find an appointment for that date and offered to book a new one.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: The agent is confirming and cancelling appointments that do not exist, which could lead to patient confusion and scheduling errors.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent "confirms" rescheduling an appointment that does not exist (hallucinated record)
